svg.text: Cut 180 x 75 mm from 3 mm sheet; round the corners about 2 mm.

svg.text: Heights up from the bottom edge; sideways from the centre line.

svg.text: Lug holes: 5.5 mm, 62 mm each side, 15 up (FieldNode's lower lugs).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sun shield holes (hot sites): drill 3.3 mm and tap M4, 84 mm each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side, 64 up. Drill them on every node; they cost nothing.

svg.text: Rail bolts: 5.5 mm on the centre line, 12 and 62 up, countersunk
